Unequal energies give unequal weights when beta is nonzero (and lower energy receives higher weight when beta is positive).
For alpha=1/4, positive beta and strictly positive variance, lag-zero response is positive and both defined correlation and response decay geometrically by1/2.
The fep040 Gaussian thermal entropy with U(T)=T/2 satisfies the premise at positive scale and temperature, yielding a nonconstant mathematical model with explicit dimensionless units.
